worked_example.problem: A hospital patient with diabetes needs a special plan for what to eat each day. Who should make the plan?
steps: A special diet for a patient is planned by a health professional who knows nutrition.
That is the job of a dietitian.

cards.idea: Some food careers prepare food: chef, cook, caterer, baker.
example: A caterer prepares food for a wedding of three hundred guests.

cards.idea: Some food careers advise, teach or check: dietitian, nutritionist, food inspector, Home Economics teacher.
example: A food inspector visits restaurants to check that food is safe.

cards.idea: Food careers need knowledge of Home Economics, Biology and Chemistry, and good hygiene.
example: A baker must wash hands and keep the bakery clean.

check.prompt: Which is a career in food and nutrition?

questions.prompt: Match each job with what the person does.

pool.right: plans special diets for patients, for example in a hospital
teaches people how to eat well
cooks and plans meals in a hotel or restaurant
prepares and serves food for events such as weddings
studies food and makes new food products
checks that food sold to people is clean and safe
teaches food, nutrition and home management in school
serves food to customers in a restaurant

pick.t: plans special diets for patients, for example in a hospital
pick.why: Dietitian: plans special diets for patients, for example in a hospital.

pick.t: teaches people how to eat well
pick.why: Nutritionist: teaches people how to eat well.

pick.t: cooks and plans meals in a hotel or restaurant
pick.why: Chef: cooks and plans meals in a hotel or restaurant.

pick.t: prepares and serves food for events such as weddings
pick.why: Caterer: prepares and serves food for events such as weddings.
Baker: makes bread, cakes and pastries.

pick.t: studies food and makes new food products
pick.why: Food scientist: studies food and makes new food products.

pick.t: checks that food sold to people is clean and safe
pick.why: Food inspector: checks that food sold to people is clean and safe.

pick.t: teaches food, nutrition and home management in school
pick.why: Home Economics teacher: teaches food, nutrition and home management in school.

pick.t: serves food to customers in a restaurant
pick.why: Waiter or waitress: serves food to customers in a restaurant.

misconceptions.explain: Not this job. Read what each person does.

questions.prompt: What do people in food careers need most?

right.text: good hygiene and knowledge of food and nutrition

wrong.explain: Some jobs need it, but food careers need hygiene and food knowledge.
Food careers need knowledge and hygiene, not only strength.
That does not help to prepare safe, healthy food.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A baker makes bread and cakes.
A caterer prepares food for events.
A food inspector checks that food is safe.
A chef cooks in a hotel or restaurant.

wrong.explain: A dietitian plans special diets for patients.
A nutritionist teaches people how to eat well.

wrong.text: A food scientist serves customers in a restaurant.
wrong.explain: Waiters serve customers; a food scientist studies food and makes new products.
